external_admissibility.species_with_nonfinite_edge_predictor: drop species before split and record reason
external_admissibility.species_with_rank_deficient_predictor_ma: drop species before split and record reason

predictor_information.per_species_unique_fraction: variance fraction of z(M_host) remaining after intercept + z(M_self) + z(D_host_0BP)

synthetic_qualification.primary_test: one-sample one-sided t statistic on equal-species beta_host_s estimates
synthetic_qualification.null_structure: preserve exact graph geometry and frozen predictors; simulate endpoint-dependent within-species responses with ordinary IBD, private spatial structure, and nuisance effects of M_self and D_host_0BP but zero mean host-memory effect
synthetic_qualification.positive_structure: same worlds plus species host-memory effects with mean standardized beta_host=0.10 and between-species SD=0.10
synthetic_qualification.private_type1_gate: Wilson 95% upper bound of rejection rate <=0.10
synthetic_qualification.positive_power_gate: Wilson 95% lower bound of rejection rate >=0.80
